name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
summary: A cable isolation exercise for the triceps that allows a full contraction by spreading the rope at the bottom.
setup: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand close to the stack.
Grip the rope with neutral palms, elbows tucked against your sides.
Lean very slightly forward with a braced core.
Start with elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
execution: Extend the elbows to push the rope down toward your thighs.
At the bottom, spread the rope ends apart and squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly until the forearms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.
cues: Spread the rope at the bottom
mistakes: Elbows drifting forward: pin them to the sides.
Leaning over the stack with body weight: stand tall and reduce load.
Letting the weight stack slam: keep tension through the top.
Using the shoulders to push: keep shoulders down and still.
